findings.claim: The project is a RESTful Booking API platform named en2h-booking-api built for service management and service booking.
The project provides a backend solution allowing authenticated users to manage service listings while allowing public customers to create bookings with duplicate prevention.
The stack uses NestJS v11 framework, Prisma v7.8.0 ORM with PostgreSQL using the @prisma/adapter-pg driver adapter, Passport JWT, class-validator, and Docker.
The application follows NestJS modular architecture, organizing business logic into core modules including PrismaModule, AuthModule, ServicesModule, and BookingsModule.
Authentication features endpoints for user registration, user login, and access token refreshing using JWT.
Interactive OpenAPI documentation is configured via Swagger and served at /api/docs.
Global exception handling maps Prisma error codes P2002 to 409 HTTP Conflict and P2025 to 404 HTTP Not Found.
PrismaService configures PostgreSQL connectivity using pg.Pool adapter wrapped inside PrismaPg adapter.
Database seed script creates a default admin user with plain-text password 'password123' and two initial services.
AuthModule includes a fallback string 'super-secret' if JWT_SECRET environment variable is not defined.
The Dockerfile employs a two-stage Alpine build process that executes Prisma migrations on container deployment.
Complete implementation source code for AuthService, ServicesModule controllers/services, and BookingsModule controllers/services is missing from the supplied file context.
